architecture.candidate_path: opposite unit scans -> identical canonical kernel -> polynomial exact component solvers -> outward SAT reconstruction

scientific_reading.positive: The meet-then-diverge architecture can terminate exactly on a nontrivial existing-workload subset using only polynomial candidate primitives, while preserving exact meeting and replayable SAT reconstruction.
scientific_reading.negative: 49 of 72 cases remain OPEN because their central kernels are still general CNF. The candidate path is therefore not total for arbitrary CNF.
scientific_reading.cost_note: This run was an architecture/exactness test, not a speedup claim: candidate charged ops exceeded shadow DPLL work on aggregate.
scientific_reading.next_target: Classify the 49 OPEN central kernels and add only exact polynomial terminal classes or a proved polynomial central generator/compression. Do not reintroduce R6-quarantined exhaustive search.
